records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Timber Group!
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, kickoff held [calendar:71f6c467] but no project, no invite, no milestone, and no reply to welcome [email:dfdc1921] or tickets. Engaged enough to attend kickoff, yet zero in-product progress since; 8 days left on a Starter solo account suggests low-to-moderate unaided odds.

draft.subject: Getting Timber Group's first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the kickoff call last week. Now that we've talked through how your team works today, the natural next step is getting that first project into Wrenfield — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you and map your current workflow onto it.

Best,
Chidi
